chance: open vocabulary, so arm B's expectation is ~0; a non-trivial arm B score means the questions carry text priors and those items must be cut, not scored
scoring: exact match on the normalised consensus answer
limitation: Natural images with objective answers, but TextVQA is text-in-image heavy: it exercises OCR and fine detail far more than counting or spatial reasoning. Pair it with the synthetic set rather than replacing it.
